fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.name: hero_description
fields.default_value: In a feed-driven economy, 9:16 video is the single highest-leverage conversion asset. We script, direct, shoot, and edit commercial-grade vertical videos that hook attention within the first 3 seconds.

fields.label: About this section
fields.message: The dark band under the hero. Each item needs a value; clear it to drop that column. With all four cleared the whole band is hidden.

fields.label: About this tab
fields.message:
The reels themselves are the Client Reels entries, each with its own fields and "Show on" box. This tab only holds the labels around them.

The category pills come from each reel's Category, and only categories that have reels are shown.

fields.label: Filter: all reels
fields.name: gallery_all_label
fields.instructions: The first filter pill. Blank hides the pill row.

fields.label: Book a shoot button
fields.name: gallery_cta_label
fields.instructions: Opens the Book a Discovery Call form. Blank hides the button.

fields.label: Views suffix
fields.name: gallery_views_suffix
fields.instructions: Follows the view count on a reel, e.g. "2.4M Views".

fields.label: CTR suffix
fields.name: gallery_ctr_suffix
fields.instructions: Follows the click-through rate, e.g. "4.1% CTR".

fields.label: Where to edit this
fields.message:
The Studio Showcase gallery is shared with the Home page, so the shoots are edited in one place: Pages → Home → Studio Showcase.

To hide the section on this page only, untick Studio Showcase in the Page Sections box.

fields.label: About this section
fields.message:
The pricing shown on /reels. Each page has its own pricing, so changing it here does not affect the Home or Services pages.

To hide the section on this page, untick Growth Plans in the Page Sections box instead of clearing these fields.
